subject: Initiating MAP & evaluation plan for NovaMed - kickoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@novamed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initiating MAP & evaluation plan for NovaMed - kickoff

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I wanted to formalize a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have clear owners, success criteria, and a close timeline that aligns with your internal eval window. Proposed high-level plan below: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood for regulated clinical note generation workflows (privacy + latency targets)
- Evaluation length: 6 weeks (target pilot complete by 2026-07-15)
- Success criteria: 1) 95% PII redaction on our test set, 2) median response time < 400ms for 512-token context, 3) acceptable quality per NovaMed eval rubric
- Key owners: Samantha (Champion), Alan Murray (Evaluation lead), Jordan Blake (AE), Marcus Lin (SE), Monica Patel (CS)
- Next steps: 1) confirm stakeholders and procurement timeline, 2) kickoff call in the next 2 business days, 3) exchange MAP doc + SOW

Proposed kickoff windows (PT):
- Thu Jun 3, 10:00–10:45am
- Fri Jun 4, 9:00–9:45am or 11:00–11:45am

I attached a short intro slide deck so you can share with any additional stakeholders (attachment: NovaMed-Intro-Slides.pdf). I’ll also draft an initial MAP and shared Drive link after we confirm the kickoff slot.

If the procurement timeline is later than mid-July, call that out and we’ll adjust the target close date accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: NovaMed-Intro-Slides.pdf (8 slides, overview + proposed eval plan)
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiating MAP & evaluation plan for NovaMed - kickoff

Thanks Jordan — this is helpful and aligned with what we discussed. I’m happy to be the champion and will drive internal coordination. A couple items from our side: 

- Evaluation lead: Alan Murray (I've looped him on this thread; alan.murray@novamed.com)
- Procurement: procurement@novamed.com (they manage contracts and timelines)
- Success criteria: I attached our internal success rubric for the evaluation (attachment: NovaMed-success-criteria.docx). Please take a look and we can reconcile metrics on the kickoff call.

Regarding timeline: our internal stakeholders prefer a slightly later signature target to allow legal & security review — can we push the contract close target to ~2026-07-20? The evaluation can still run in June/July, but procurement will likely need through mid-July to finalize.

For kickoff, Fri Jun 4 at 11:00am PT works best for the technical team. If that’s okay with you and Marcus, please send the invite.

Appreciate the slide deck — I’ll share with Alan and procurement before the call.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Director of Clinical Innovation, NovaMed
samantha.ortiz@novamed.com

Subject: Re: Initiating MAP & evaluation plan for NovaMed - kickoff

Great — Fri Jun 4, 11:00am PT is locked on my side. I sent a calendar invite to all.

I updated the MAP to reflect the procurement buffer you mentioned and pushed the suggested close date to 2026-07-22. Draft is attached (NovaMed-MAP-v1.docx) and I also created a shared Drive folder with the materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-NovaMed-MAP 

On the kickoff I propose this agenda (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (5 min)
- Review success criteria and test plan (10 min)
- Logistics: data access, security checklist, and timeline (10 min)
- Next steps & owners (5–10 min)

Marcus will walk through an initial test harness and what we’ll need from Alan to run parallel runs. Monica will cover onboarding and CS support. 

Action items before the call: 
- Samantha/Alan: confirm any additional stakeholders and whether we should include your security lead on the kickoff (procurement and legal can join optional)
- Jordan/Marcus/Monica: we’ll upload the SOW draft and a technical checklist to the Drive before the call.

Looking forward — see you on Friday.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
